recovery_v16.root_cause: Win7 materializes an absent mandatory-label ACL as a valid zero-ACE ACL after label removal; v15 treated the two equivalent LABEL representations as different. certutil also returned 0x800703EE for an empty redirected stderr evidence file.
recovery_v16.fix: Treat null and zero-ACE ACLs as equivalent only for LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION while preserving strict DACL comparison; retry certutil and allow the canonical empty SHA-256 only after a remote zero-byte size proof.

recovery_v17.root_cause: The restricted Win7 child returned ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED from localized whoami /groups, so the harness could not independently observe S-1-16-4096 even though the file, registry, privilege, ACL rollback and postflight probes behaved correctly.
recovery_v17.fix: Before ResumeThread, open the actual suspended child process token and require TokenPrimary, IsTokenRestricted=true, TokenIntegrityLevel SID S-1-16-4096 and RID 4096; emit the structured tokenAudit and fail closed on any query or mismatch. whoami /groups remains supplemental only.
recovery_v17.field_failure: Ordinary CMD smoke reached suspended child creation, then the actual child-token audit failed before ResumeThread and returned TOKEN_CREATE_FAILED.
recovery_v17.source_root_cause: CreateRestrictedToken passed RestrictedSidCount=0 and SidsToRestrict=nullptr, while AuditRestrictedChildToken required IsTokenRestricted() == true. Without a restricting SID list IsTokenRestricted is deterministically false.
recovery_v17.evidence_note: The smoke error was reported by the user; no machine-generated v17 return ZIP or log bundle was available for archiving.

recovery_v18.root_cause: The v17 restricted token contained no restricting SID, contradicting its IsTokenRestricted audit contract.
recovery_v18.fix: Create and pass World/Everyone as the sole SidsToRestrict entry while keeping World enabled in the normal SID set; audit the actual suspended child TokenRestrictedSids and require exactly one World SID together with TokenPrimary and Low Integrity S-1-16-4096 before ResumeThread.

recovery_v20.trigger: v19 Win10 smoke failure and corrupted PowerShell 5.1 native-output capture
recovery_v20.root_cause: The source token's legal empty TokenRestrictedSids result contains only a DWORD GroupCount=0 header, but v19 required sizeof(TOKEN_GROUPS). Windows PowerShell 5.1 also decoded UTF-8 helper output with the host code page before recording it, corrupting Chinese JSON error text.
recovery_v20.fix: Accept the DWORD header for an empty restricted-SID set while bounds-checking non-empty arrays. Capture stdout/stderr BaseStream bytes concurrently, persist with WriteAllBytes, then decode with strict UTF-8 before JSON parsing.
recovery_v20.local_validation: PASS (logic tests; containment 37/37; D-013 harness; MinGW 5-unit warning-clean compile and PE32+ x64 link; dry-run zero SSH/SCP)
